name: life-os-workstation
description: Local-first Personal AI / Life OS runtime, connectors, and account-side gates for Aren's always-on Mac mini.

install.note: Installation does not authenticate a Gmail account. Connect each approved Gmail account through the Codex Gmail connector.
Installs the TickTick and imsg CLIs when missing, initializes private local state, and creates the launcher. OAuth and macOS privacy permissions remain manual.

manual_checks.description: Run `./scripts/life-os-host-preflight` on the production Mac mini. Required checks are Mac mini hardware, AC system sleep disabled, ChatGPT installed/running/opening at login, and a live private Tailscale connection; Remote Login is reported separately for remote maintenance.
Verified 2026-08-11: OAuth succeeded and bounded reads observed 25 projects and 160 open tasks. Re-run `ticktick auth status` and the bounded canary after token or machine changes.
Connect and behaviorally verify every approved Gmail account through the Codex Gmail connector; installation alone is insufficient.

On this host, ChatGPT.app is the observed parent of the Codex runtime. Grant that desktop app Full Disk Access, restart it, verify bounded `imsg` reads, and grant Messages Automation only before a confirmed send canary.
Register an Oura OAuth application with minimum daily scope, exchange the authorization code, and verify a bounded read-only sync.
Configure a deliberately limited Health Auto Export JSON flow and verify ingestion; the Life OS never writes health data.
Review a bounded representative sample and approve the iMessage, personal email, and professional email voice rules.

The 2026-08-11 evening review completed safely with connector blind spots and durable output. Verify connected first runs for morning, communications, evening, and weekly tasks, plus duplicate prevention, in the local agent-tooling project.

Local non-copying Codex/Claude skill symlinks are installed on this workstation. After explicit commit/push approval, refresh personal@agent-tooling and verify implicit invocation on another machine; Scheduled tasks read the local skill files before publication.
